description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search business registration status by business registration number (사업자등록번호).

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

txpr_dscm_no.description: Business registration number 사업자등록번호 (10 digits, hyphens stripped automatically, e.g. '1234567890' or '123-45-67890').

name: hometax__tax__business_registration__search_status
title: 사업자등록 상태 조회
